words.ex: I met up with my old friend at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 我在杂货店偶然碰到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To come together with someone, especially after arranging to do so.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: The treatment plant cleans the wastewater before it is released into the river.
words.ex_cn: 处理厂在废水排入河流之前将其净化。
words.en: Water that has been used in homes, industries, and businesses that is not for reuse unless treated.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: The cat jumped into the box.
words.en: If you go into a place or thing, you move from the outside to the inside of it.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: They go on a trip every summer.
words.en: To go on a trip means to travel somewhere, especially for pleasure or a holiday.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；极坏的；糟糕的；
words.ex: The storm caused a terrible flood.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了一场可怕的洪水。
words.en: If something is terrible, it is very bad or of very poor quality.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: The green leaf fell from the tree.
words.en: A leaf is one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.en: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同； 同意； 适合于
words.ex: I agree with you on this point.
words.en: to have the same opinion as someone else; to accept a suggestion or idea
